sentences: This bill is part of a package that would give Australia Day legal status as a national day in federal law.
The bill would fix 26 January as the date of Australia Day and require any future change to be decided by a national plebiscite.
The plebiscite would be open to people eligible to vote in federal elections, and any alternative date must include 26 January as an option.
changes: Establishes Australia Day as a national day in federal law.
Sets 26 January as the official date.
Requires a national plebiscite for any future date change.
Stipulates that 26 January must be an option in the plebiscite.
Limits voting in the plebiscite to those qualified to vote in federal elections.
summary.affected: All Australians, particularly those eligible to vote in federal elections.
